row.evidence: Influitive's support centre documents SAML 2.0 SSO ("Single Sign-on may not be available in your plan") with admin accounts created by hand first, and for its PostBeyond product answers "Is there any SCIM integration for de-provisioning users? No."
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Quote-only pricing (Customer Advocacy and Digital Community, both 'Talk with Sales'); no SCIM documented, so normal none rules apply (not 6a). Scored as AdvocateHub, Influitive's main product; PostBeyond (employee advocacy, same support centre) also says it has no SCIM and offers API-based archiving via the CSM. AdvocateHub SSO is SAML 2.0 or OAuth 2 and may not be in every plan (contact CSM), so sso_plan is null. Corporate/admin users must be created in Admin User Management before SSO works; advocates can sign up through SSO. The public Influitive REST API (api.influitive.com, Authorization token + X_ORG_ID) manages members, including lock/unlock of Advocate and Admin members. Okta's OIN 'Influitive' app is SWA only (Feb. 16 2015); the OIN 'PostBeyond' app is SAML only (Dec. 28 2017); checked items read from page markup.

scim.notes: No SCIM article in the Influitive support centre (search 'scim' returns only the PostBeyond SAML article, which says no SCIM). AdvocateHub SSO is SAML 2.0 or OAuth 2; false for AdvocateHub is by absence (rule 5).

endpoints.purpose: Create a member identified by email
Lock a member (Advocates and Admin members)
Query all members in the AdvocateHub

rate_limits.text: 200 requests per IP address per 5 minutes; AWS WAF bot detection may block suspicious traffic.

user_api.notes: Member API is aimed at advocates but lock/unlock explicitly covers Admin members. Which plans include the API is not stated (quote-only). Endpoint paths copied from the ReadMe OpenAPI definitions (server https://api.influitive.com). PostBeyond's user-archiving API is only shared by the CSM.

okta.notes: OIN 'Influitive' app is SWA only (checked items read from page markup). AdvocateHub SAML with Okta is configured as a custom app per Influitive's guides. The separate OIN 'PostBeyond' app is SAML only (IdP-initiated).

onelogin.notes: Influitive's Admin Only SSO guide names Okta and OneLogin; OneLogin catalogue not checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: PostBeyond: CSM-provided API to archive users when deactivated in Active Directory; AdvocateHub: Salesforce/Marketo/Zapier integrations for advocate data.
fallbacks.notes: With SAML on, anybody in the customer's system can sign up to the hub (advocate JIT); corporate/admin users must be pre-created with a matching email. Admins are added and disabled in Admin User Management. Advocates can be bulk-imported by CSV.
